Question: Let \([t]\) denote the greatest integer not exceeding \(t,\) where \(t\ge0,\) and \[ \begin{aligned} S=\{(x,y):{}&(x-T)^2+y^2\\ &\le T^2\},\\ T&=t-[t]. \end{aligned} \] Then we have

Choices.A: the point \((0,0)\) does not belong to \(S\) for any \(t\)
Choices.C: \(S\) is contained in the first quadrant for all \(t\ge5\)
Choices.D: the center of \(S\) for any \(t\) is on the line \(y=x\)
Choices.E: none of the other statements is true
